title: Open Water Scuba Diver
description: This beginner-level course is the most popular diving course in the world. It offers ocean lovers the opportunity to discover the wonderful underwater world through the unforgettable experience of taking their first breath underwater. During this course, you will learn the fundamental principles of scuba diving, become familiar with the use of specialized diving equipment, and develop the skills needed to dive independently with a buddy, safely and confidently.
min_age: Minimum age 15 by the in-water phase of the course. The Junior Open Water Scuba Diver certification is issued to children aged 10–14.
min_hours: Theoretical part 14 (fourteen) hours (estimated) Practical part 17 (seventeen) hours, including at least 10 hours in the water.
min_dives: A minimum of four open-water dives is required.
certification: No certification is required to enrol in this course.
seo_title: Open Water Diving Certification Cyprus | Net Divers
seo_description: Learn scuba diving and get your first diving certification with the NAUI Open Water Scuba Diver course at Net Divers diving school, Ayia Napa.

title: Advanced Open Water Scuba Diver
description: This continuing education course provides divers with the fundamental knowledge covered in five (5) specialty courses, including Deep Diver, Night & Limited Visibility Diver, Search & Recovery Diver, Underwater Digital Imaging Diver, and Wreck Diver (External Survey). The knowledge and skills you acquire will help you further develop your diving techniques while learning to use new equipment and gaining new experiences and knowledge that will help you discover your areas of interest.
min_age: Minimum age 15 by the in-water phase of the course. The Junior Open Water Scuba Diver certification is issued to children aged 10–14.
min_hours: Theoretical part 6 (six) hours (estimated) Practical part 6 (six) hours
min_dives: A minimum of six open-water dives is required.
certification: NAUI Open Water Scuba Diver certification or equivalent is required.
seo_title: Advanced Open Water Certification Cyprus | Net Divers
seo_description: NAUI Advanced Open Water: your next diving certification in Cyprus, with deeper dives, navigation and new skills on Cyprus' best dive sites.

title: Enriched Air Nitrox Diver
description:
This continuing-education course provides the knowledge and skills required to use enriched air Nitrox containing 32% or 40% oxygen as a breathing gas while diving.
Diving with enriched air Nitrox increases bottom time and reduces decompression time and surface intervals between dives compared with diving on regular air. During this course, you will practise using oxygen analysers and learn to identify cylinder markings to determine whether a cylinder can be used with enriched air. You will also learn how to set your dive computer for enriched-air Nitrox dives and plan your dives.
min_age: Minimum age 15 by the in-water phase of the course. The Junior Open Water Scuba Diver certification is issued to children aged 10–14.
min_hours: Theoretical part 2 (two) hours (estimated) Practical part 2 (two) hours
min_dives: A minimum of two (2) open-water dives is required.
certification: NAUI Open Water Scuba Diver certification or equivalent is required.
seo_title: Nitrox Diver Course Cyprus | NAUI | Net Divers
seo_description: NAUI Enriched Air Nitrox Diver course in Cyprus. Dive longer with less nitrogen and plan nitrox dives safely. Training in Ayia Napa with Net Divers.

title: Master Scuba Diver
description:
This continuing-education course is for certified divers who want to expand their diving-related knowledge and skills. This certification distinguishes you as more than a holder of a basic certification: it recognizes a diver with comprehensive knowledge and extensive experience in different diving environments (e.g. night diving, deep diving and navigation).
The Master Scuba Diver is not a professional diver, but a diver with extensive experience and advanced diving skills. If you want to become a professional diver, you should take the Divemaster Leadership course.
min_age: Minimum age 15 by the in-water phase of the course.
min_hours: Theory: approximately 23 hours. Practical training: approximately 8 hours.
min_dives: A minimum of eight (8) open-water dives is required.
certification: NAUI Advanced Open Water Scuba Diver and Rescue Scuba Diver certifications, or equivalents, are required.
seo_title: Master Scuba Diver Course Cyprus | NAUI | Net Divers
seo_description: Reach NAUI Master Scuba Diver in Cyprus, the highest recreational diving rating. Advanced theory and specialty dives with Net Divers, Ayia Napa.

title: Rescue Scuba Diver
description: This continuing-education course provides divers with the knowledge and skills needed to manage emergencies and various hazards, and to respond effectively to specific problems both in and out of the water. The course includes surface rescues and rescues from depth, with or without scuba equipment, from both boats and shore. It fulfils the rescue-training prerequisite for certifications such as Skin Diving Instructor, Assistant Instructor, Divemaster and Instructor.
min_age: Minimum age 15 by the in-water phase of the course.
min_hours: 4 hours of theory and 4 hours of practical training out of the water.
min_dives: A minimum of two open-water dives is required.
certification: Open Water Scuba Diver certification is required. A current Diving First Aid certification is also required. If you do not have this certification, you can obtain it during Rescue Scuba Diver training as an additional specialty.
seo_title: Rescue Scuba Diver Course Cyprus | NAUI | Net Divers
seo_description: NAUI Rescue Scuba Diver course in Cyprus. Learn to prevent and handle diving emergencies and assist other divers. Training with Net Divers.

title: Basic Life Support – CPR & First Aid
description: This NAUI course, supported by DAN (Divers Alert Network), focuses on emergency-scene assessment, first aid for adults, children and infants, CPR (with or without an automated external defibrillator), and techniques for stabilizing an injured person until medical services arrive. The skills you gain are useful not only in the diving world but also in everyday life with family, friends, neighbors and colleagues.
min_age: There is no minimum age to participate in this course.
min_hours: Theory: approximately 2–3 hours. Practical training: approximately 4–6 hours.
certification: Scuba certification is not required to take this course. This certification must be renewed every two years.
seo_title: CPR & First Aid Course Cyprus | Net Divers
seo_description: Basic Life Support, CPR and First Aid course in Cyprus. Gain the skills to act in an emergency, in and out of the water. Training with Net Divers.

title: Emergency Oxygen for Scuba Diving Injuries
description: This NAUI course, supported by DAN (Divers Alert Network), focuses on how to administer oxygen in diving emergencies, such as decompression sickness. In addition, you will learn how to recognize the signs and symptoms of decompression sickness and respond accordingly. Upon completion of the course, the skills you acquire will be applicable not only in the world of diving but also in your everyday life with your family, friends, neighbors, and colleagues.
min_age: There is no minimum age to participate in this course.
min_hours: Theory: approximately 1–2 hours. Practical training: approximately 3–4 hours.
certification: Scuba certification is not required to take this course. This certification must be renewed every two years.
seo_title: Emergency Oxygen for Diving Injuries Cyprus | Net Divers
seo_description: Learn to give emergency oxygen for scuba diving injuries. A practical NAUI course in Cyprus for divers and dive staff, with Net Divers.

title: Diving First Aid
description:
This NAUI course, supported by DAN (Divers Alert Network), includes all the components of the following courses: 
- Basic Life Support (BLS), CPR & First Aid 
- Emergency Oxygen for Scuba Diving Injuries (EO2) 

It also teaches you how to properly assess and manage neurological injuries, provide first aid for injuries caused by hazardous marine life, and much more. It is the most comprehensive first-aid course in the diving industry. It is designed for all divers and meets the needs of commercial, professional and scientific divers by providing first-aid knowledge and skills specific to these environments. The course fulfils the rescue-training prerequisite for certifications such as: 
-Rescue Diver 
-Assistant Instructor 
-Divemaster and Instructor. 

The skills you gain are useful not only in the diving world but also in everyday life with family, friends, neighbours and colleagues.
min_age: There is no minimum age to participate in this course.
min_hours: Theory: approximately 6–8 hours. Practical training: approximately 6–8 hours.
certification: Scuba certification is not required to take this course. This certification must be renewed every two years.
seo_title: Diving First Aid Course Cyprus | NAUI | Net Divers
seo_description: NAUI Diving First Aid course in Cyprus. Recognise and manage diving injuries, from decompression illness to marine life injuries. With Net Divers.

title: Deep Diver
description: This specialty course provides divers with further knowledge of the physics of deep diving, specialized equipment, air supply management, and safety considerations. All of this offers divers unforgettable experiences and even more opportunities to explore the magical underwater world.
min_age: Minimum age 15 by the in-water phase of the course.
min_hours: Theory: approximately 2 hours. Practical training: approximately 2 hours.
min_dives: A minimum of two (2) open-water dives is required.
certification: NAUI Advanced Open Water Scuba Diver certification or equivalent is required.
seo_title: Deep Diver Course Cyprus | NAUI | Net Divers
seo_description: NAUI Deep Diver course in Cyprus. Plan and make deeper dives safely on wrecks and walls like the Zenobia. Scuba diving training with Net Divers.

title: Night and Limited Visibility Diver
description: This specialty-training course gives divers specific knowledge of dive-light handling, communication signals and orientation in limited visibility. You will practise the techniques needed to dive safely and confidently at night. These skills allow divers to discover a magical underwater world that comes alive after dark.
min_age: Minimum age 15. The Junior Night and Limited Visibility Diver certification is issued to children aged 10–14.
min_hours: Theory: approximately 2 hours. Practical training: approximately 2 hours.
min_dives: A minimum of two (2) open-water dives is required.
max_depth: 40 metres (130 feet), or according to the diver's qualifications.
certification: NAUI Open Water Scuba Diver certification or equivalent is required.
seo_title: Night Diving Course Cyprus | NAUI | Net Divers
seo_description: NAUI Night and Limited Visibility Diver course in Cyprus. Discover the sea after dark and dive confidently in low visibility with Net Divers.

title: Wreck Diver (External Survey)
description: This specialty-training course gives divers specific knowledge of dive planning around reefs and wrecks, locating wrecks, diving in limited visibility and maintaining buoyancy while respecting the environment. It focuses on safety, hazard management and ways to protect yourself in environments with various obstacles. These skills allow divers to discover the real history of the underwater world through a wreck.
min_age: Minimum age 15. The Junior Wreck Diver (External Survey) certification is issued to children aged 10–14.
min_hours: Theory: approximately 2 hours. Practical training: approximately 2 hours.
min_dives: A minimum of two (2) open-water dives is required.
certification: NAUI Advanced Open Water Scuba Diver certification or equivalent is required.
seo_title: Wreck Diver Course Cyprus | NAUI | Net Divers
seo_description: NAUI Wreck Diver (External Survey) course in Cyprus, home of the Zenobia, Liberty and Nemesis wrecks. Learn safe wreck diving with Net Divers.

title: Underwater Digital Imaging Diver
description: This specialty-training course gives divers specific knowledge of underwater camera use, photo and/or video techniques, lighting techniques, and the basic principles of photography and/or videography. It focuses on solving problems in the underwater environment related to air consumption, depth and dive time, buoyancy control while respecting the environment, and staying close to a dive buddy. These skills allow divers to photograph underwater life in a magical underwater world, where every detail in the frame tells a unique story to share with friends and family.
min_age: Minimum age 15. The Junior Underwater Digital Imaging Diver certification is issued to children aged 10–14.
min_hours: Theory: approximately 4 hours. Practical training: approximately 4 hours.
min_dives: A minimum of two (2) open-water dives is required.
max_depth: 40 metres (130 feet), or according to the diver's qualifications.
certification: NAUI Open Water Scuba Diver certification or equivalent is required.
seo_title: Underwater Photography Course Cyprus | Net Divers
seo_description: NAUI Underwater Digital Imaging Diver course in Cyprus. Learn underwater photography and video in Cyprus' clear waters with Net Divers.

title: Search and Recovery Diver
description: This specialty-training course gives divers specific knowledge of using specialised equipment for orientation, locating and recovering objects underwater, including in limited visibility or murky water. Divers learn to use maps and compasses, methods for locating search areas, and the hazards and safety procedures needed to make underwater searching safe and enjoyable.
min_age: Minimum age 15. The Junior Search and Recovery Diver certification is issued to children aged 10–14.
min_hours: Theory: approximately 3 hours. Practical training: approximately 2 hours.
min_dives: A minimum of two (2) open-water dives is required.
max_depth: 40 metres (130 feet), or according to the diver's qualifications.
certification: NAUI Open Water Scuba Diver certification or equivalent is required.
seo_title: Search and Recovery Diver Course Cyprus | Net Divers
seo_description: NAUI Search and Recovery Diver course in Cyprus. Learn search patterns, lift bags and safe object recovery underwater with Net Divers.

title: Underwater Naturalist Diver
description: This specialty-training course gives divers specific knowledge of methods for recording population densities of selected species; observation techniques (e.g. passive observation, photography, grid, quadrat and transect methods); the characteristics and behaviour of underwater animals; the general morphology of kelp forests and reefs; and marine flora and fauna. These skills improve diving ability while minimising the diver's impact on the environment. The course emphasises diving safety, hazards and precautions for different environments, as well as improving diver rescue and protection methods.
min_age: Minimum age 15. The Junior Underwater Naturalist Diver certification is issued to children aged 10–14.
min_hours: Theory: approximately 3 hours. Practical training: approximately 3 hours.
min_dives: A minimum of two (2) open-water dives is required.
max_depth: 40 metres (130 feet), or according to the diver's qualifications.
certification: NAUI Open Water Scuba Diver certification or equivalent is required.
seo_title: Underwater Naturalist Course Cyprus | Net Divers
seo_description: NAUI Underwater Naturalist Diver course in Cyprus. Identify Mediterranean marine life and learn to dive with respect for the environment.

title: Divemaster
description: This course gives divers the qualifications and knowledge to take the step just below becoming a diving instructor. With this certification, you can work as a professional diver at a dive centre or dive school. If you love diving and want to share your passion for the sea by turning your hobby into a career, this course is for you. You will learn how to teach scuba-diving skills, organise dives, and assess and understand divers' behaviour.
min_age: Minimum age 18 before enrolment and the start of training.
min_hours: Theory: approximately 20 hours. Practical training: approximately 20 hours.
min_dives: A minimum of 20 open-water dives is required.
certification: Requires 60 dives and 30 hours underwater at various depths and in different conditions (day, night, shore and boat dives). A medical fitness certificate signed by a doctor within the last 12 months is required. NAUI Assistant Instructor certification is required, or the following NAUI certifications or equivalents: (a) Open Water Scuba Diver, (b) Advanced Open Water Scuba Diver, (c) Rescue Scuba Diver, (d) Nitrox Diver, and (e) current Diving First Aid certification.
seo_title: Divemaster Course: Become a Professional Diver | Net Divers
seo_description: Become a professional diver with the NAUI Divemaster or Divemaster Crossover course in Cyprus. Lead dives and assist instructors with Net Divers.

title: Assistant Instructor
description: This course is the first level of your professional training. With this certification, you can work as a professional diver at a dive centre or dive school, assist instructors during training and dives, and teach certain topics as an instructor. If your dream is to share your experience and love of diving through training and to guide certified divers on exciting underwater excursions, this first leadership course is for you.
min_age: Minimum age 18 before enrolment and the start of training.
min_hours: Theory: approximately 13 hours. Practical training: approximately 7 hours.
min_dives: A minimum of two (2) open-water dives is required.
certification: Requires 50 dives and 25 hours underwater at various depths and in different conditions (day, night, shore and boat dives). A medical fitness certificate signed by a doctor within the last 12 months is required. The following NAUI certifications or equivalents are required: (a) Open Water Scuba Diver, (b) Advanced Open Water Scuba Diver, (c) Rescue Scuba Diver, (d) Nitrox Diver, and (e) current Diving First Aid certification.
seo_title: Assistant Instructor: Become a Diving Instructor | Net Divers
seo_description: NAUI Assistant Instructor course in Cyprus: your first step to becoming a diving instructor, with professional training from Net Divers, Ayia Napa.
